aliases: Applied Digital Oliver County AI Factory

location.site_description: Project Site in Section 24, Township 142 North, Range 85 West, Oliver County, North Dakota; access from State Highway 31 via a private driveway at or near the Section 23 quarter-section line and from State Highway 25 via a DOT-managed approach.
location.nearby_reference: Near Center / south of Hanover, around the State Highways 25 and 31 area.

status_as_of_cutoff: As of 2026-08-11, local-process / pre-construction-enabling status. Oliver County has posted a Road Use and Operation Agreement effective 2026-07-10 between Oliver County and APLD BIS-01, LLC for construction access to a Project Site in Section 24, Township 142 North, Range 85 West. County agendas list Applied Digital building-permit items on 2026-06-25 (#1096: two data center buildings and security building), 2026-07-30 (#1101: one data center foundation/shell for BIS02), and 2026-08-10 Planning & Zoning updates for #1101, but the reviewed official pages are agendas/notices rather than approval minutes. NDPSC Case PU-26-235 for the APLD BIS-01 electric service agreement remains open with no close date and a 2026-09-07 hearing-request deadline; related temporary construction load and temporary service switchyard cases PU-26-219 and PU-26-236 also remain open. No certificate of occupancy, energization, commissioning, full commercial service, or final NDPSC approval record was located.
evidence_grade: A- for site/location, road-use agreement, and open NDPSC docket facts; B for building-permit progress because the official records found are agenda/update listings without final approval minutes.

actions.government_body: Montana-Dakota Utilities Co. / APLD BIS-01 LLC; filed with North Dakota Public Service Commission
actions.result_status: Executed ESA attached to NDPSC Case PU-26-235; maximum service under the agreement is 430 MW, subject to facility availability and MISO/NDPSC requirements.
actions.access_caveat: Public redacted filing; NDPSC case detail shows no close date as of 2026-08-11.
actions.evidence_note: Utility-service capacity is not the same as energized capacity or critical IT load.

actions.government_body: Montana-Dakota Utilities Co. / MDU Resources Group
actions.result_status: MDU announced an ESA to provide power to Polaris Forge 3, an AI Factory near Center, North Dakota; campus would require 430 MW at full capacity and initial operations were anticipated in August 2027, subject to NDPSC approval.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement distributed by PR Newswire; regulatory approval still required.
actions.evidence_note: Supports project identity as Polaris Forge 3 and expected utility capacity.
